Name: Lens name as originally published
ra_sexa: Right ascension [d:mm:ss.ss] in sexagesimal converted from "RA_best"
Type: Double, Quad, Unknown (unspecified) or ILQ (Intermediately Lensed Quasar)
Component: System components: A, B, C, D, etc., in ascending order of brightness. G is the deflector galaxy; G1, G2, G3, etc, are other deflectors
DR3: "DR3" = true if component is matched in Gaia DR3; "DR3" = false otherwise
FPR: "FPR" = true if component is matched in Gaia FPR; "FPR" = false otherwise
GraL: "GraL" = true if the lens was detected and confirmed by Gaia GraL; "GraL" = false otherwise
Max_separation: Maximum angular separation between the lens components, calculated from "RA_best" and "DEC_best"
Author: Year of publication and first author's surname
Nb_of_published_components: Number of published components (out of date)
BibCode: NASA ADS identifier of the discovery paper
RA_pub: Right ascension [degrees] given in the literature
RA_center: Mean right ascension [degrees] of the system, calculated from "RA_best"
DEC_center: Mean declination [degrees] of the system, calculated from "DEC_best"
RA_center_sexa: Mean right ascension [d:mm:ss.ss] of the system, calculated from "RA_best"
DEC_center_sexa: Mean declination [d:mm:ss.ss] of the system, calculated from "DEC_best"
z_deflector_text: Redshift(s) of the deflector(s), separated by /
BibCode_TD: NASA ADS identifier of the time delay paper
tAB: Time delay between the system components A and B, in days
ErrtAB: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components A and B, in days
tAC: Time delay between the system components A and C, in days
ErrtAC: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components A and C, in days
tBC: Time delay between the system components B and C, in days
ErrtBC: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components B and C, in days
tAD: Time delay between the system components A and D, in days
ErrtAD: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components A and D, in days
tBD: Time delay between the system components B and D, in days
ErrtBD: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components B and D, in days
tCD: Time delay between the system components C and D, in days
ErrtCD: Uncertanty in the time delay between the system components C and D, in days
z_bibcode: BibCode from where the redshift was taken
z_SHSRC: The Southern-Hemisphere Spectroscopic Redshift Compilation redshift
flag_z_SHSRC: The Southern-Hemisphere Spectroscopic Redshift Compilation flag
class_z_SHSRC: The Southern-Hemisphere Spectroscopic Redshift Compilation class
ref_z_SHSRC: The Southern-Hemisphere Spectroscopic Redshift Compilation redshift reference
